fields.Name: TSK-08 - Chief of Staff Extension
fields.Description: The Tasks app's extension of MJ core's Chief of Staff: the Tasks skill is installed and granted to the Chief of Staff agent (CS1), the NavItem.* setting adds a well-formed Priorities & To-dos page to the Chief of Staff application (CS2), and a person's task scope covers what they own or hold plus the objective above it, and nothing else (CS3).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Skill and grant present; nav item well-formed and scoped to the Chief of Staff app; task scope matches ownership and assignment against the real Tasks view.
